cc:Work.dc:title: White Noise
cc:Work.dc:description: White noise. Flat per hertz is not flat per nanometre, or D65 white. 380–700 nm; curve normalized to its peak. CIE 1931 2 degree observer; direct sRGB/D65 conversion; peak linear RGB=1. Background #D0D7FF; clipped channels: none.

cc:Agent.dc:title: CIE (2019), doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b. CIE data and derived figure: CC BY-SA 4.0.
